what: The non-owner face-edge crease on the milestone-1 region bake in .wst version 2 (streaming.md 5.6 rule 3, 7.3 Bake check), from `npm run verify:bake` at commit a4224b0 (branch feat/4-mirror-bake), which writes it to build/lab/crease.json. A face-edge vertex takes its owner's profile entry at the vertex mip, while the non-owner tile's vertices beside it follow that tile's own grid; the crease is |h(the profile code the vertex takes) - h(the non-owner tile's own 2D mean of the four mip-m codes around the vertex)|, in meters before exaggeration. It is taken through the vertex mirror (app/src/globe/vertexMirror.ts) at every face-edge vertex of every available same-level pair drawn at d = 0 on the full tier (33 vertices a side, vertex mip 2), once per point and non-owner face (a cube corner has two). Percentiles are nearest-rank.
px30km: meters * k * 1440 / 30000: a 30 km wide view at 1440 CSS px spans 20.8 m per px at its target, and the exaggerated offset is seen side-on there. A level draws that close only where no finer tile is baked or resident yet.
pxWhereItRefines: meters * k * 0.83 / texelM(L), texelM = (pi/2) R / (256 * 2^L): where a finer level is baked, a level-L tile draws no closer than the view where its texel spans refinePx (0.83 CSS px, full tier).
gate: verify:bake holds these p95 and max values per level (bake.verify.ts CREASE_MEASURED) and fails when a level exceeds either by more than 10%.
againstV1Estimate: The tile-mesh design estimated this floor on the version 1 bake (085efb54) as each face's own mip-2 corner mean against the neighbor face's: p95 44 / 24 / 15 m, max 341 / 98 / 118 m at L4 / L5 / L6. Version 2 gives 44.2 / 24.5 / 16.0 m and 345.9 / 98.0 / 118.5 m: the owner side now sits within half a code of its own corner mean, so the non-owner side carries the two grids' whole disagreement.

ifFaceEdgeVerticesReadMip0.note: The same measure with the mirror reading the mip-0 profile entry at every face-edge vertex instead of the vertex mip (one-line mutation of vertexMirror.ts, reverted): what per-mip profiles remove. The gate fails at every level.

landChoice.note: splits: vertices whose two sides choose land and sea differently, 0 because both read the profile's shore byte. ownGridSplits: points where the non-owner's own mip-2 corner mean of shore bytes would choose differently from the profile, what each side choosing from its own grid would split.

mirrorSeams.note: Every same-level pair of available neighbors, each drawn at d = 0 on the full tier; the mirror compares the shared edge's 33 vertices from both sides in code, shore, land, h, direction and position, bit for bit.

verifyBakeSeconds.note: npm run verify:bake's vitest Duration, two runs each without and with the mirror checks; the mirror's pairs and crease take 0.63 s of the sweep
